description: The period of the continued fraction of sqrt(d). sqrt(2) has period 1, sqrt(3) has period 2, sqrt(7) has period 4, and sqrt(13) has period 5. A square is rejected. d runs from 1 to 100000. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/sqrt-period
